meaning:
σμαράγδινος
(σμάραγδος, which see),
1. of emerald (Luc., V.H., ii, 11).
2. As in π. (Deiss., BS, 267), emerald-green: Rev.4:3 (for the construction, see Swete, in l; Zorell, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
